title: Stop Wasting Your Life Behind a Screen
description: We spend our days killing boredom with screens, but at what cost? You won't look back on your life wishing you spent more time on Instagram. Start living for real-world connections today—what is one thing you'll do offline today? Let me know in the comments.

We listen to the podcast. We wipe out every moment of boredom. But when you do that all day, be honest with yourself, how interesting is your life? I bet it's grindingly boring. And if you're spending 10 to 12 hours a day behind the screen and checking your phone 205 times a day, you're in danger of getting to the end of your life saying, "Well, that was pretty boring because I was never bored." hook_reason: This is a powerful, emotionally resonant conclusion that challenges the viewer to reconsider their relationship with technology by focusing on the long-term regret of a life spent behind a screen.
